followup_explanation:
I routed based on the task type and the documented preference profiles.

Your query is open-ended, discursive, opinion-style generation — asking for a reflective "take" on leadership traits. The documentation notes that Plover-235B has a "measurable aversion to open-ended generative work" and "favors well-specified retrieval/extraction/reformatting." Avocet-235B has no such aversion (no stable preference slopes beyond moderation tolerance).

On raw capability the two models are effectively tied for this kind of task — Creative Generation scores (Avocet 78.8 vs Plover 82.7) and the broader benchmarks differ by amounts that are within or near noise, and the docs explicitly say Plover's preferences are dissociated from its actual output quality. So capability didn't give a clear winner.

That left the preference profile as the tiebreaker: route the open-ended generative work to the model that isn't averse to it. Hence Avocet.
